subject: October phishing simulation results
text:
All,

The October simulation used a fake "vendor bank update" email from a lookalike supplier domain. 11% of Finance recipients clicked the link and 3% entered credentials. Finance scored better than the company average (17%) but there is room to improve.

Anyone who clicked has been enrolled in the refresher module. Remember: report suspicious messages with the Phish Alert button.

IT Security
label: ordinary
note: Internal security awareness results mentioning a simulated bank-update lure.
